rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a physical memorial monument or marker.

example.english: The memorial at the park entrance was erected to remember those who died in that accident.
example.traditional: 公園入口嗰塊紀念碑，係為咗悼念嗰場意外入面嘅死者而立嘅。

rows.note: Use this specifically for a memorial service held to remember someone who has died.

example.english: Tomorrow night we’re going to church to attend Uncle’s memorial service.
example.traditional: 聽日夜晚我哋會去教堂參加伯伯嘅追思會。
